name: v0.8.7
body:
## What's Changed
* ci: test the Python versions the release already builds wheels for by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/195
* fix(chroot): require write authority on both sides of a hard link by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/194
* Fix connected UDP learning by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/196
* cli: drop the inert -i/--interactive flag by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/200
* learn: HTTP/HTTPS observation via transparent proxy by @ghazariann in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/197
* profile: expand ${HOME} in path fields by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/201
* Issue 183 riscv64 checkpoint restore by @sachin2605 in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/192
* checkpoint: riscv64 post-merge review follow-ups by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/203
* resource: fix parallel-run flake in the memory ledger test by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/204
* policy_fn: join the callback thread before the sandbox returns by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/205
* COW: mediate openat2 and renameat; build the restore stub without SSP by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/206
* control: replace the /dev/shm registry with abstract Unix sockets by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/207


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/compare/v0.8.6...v0.8.7

name: v0.8.6
body:
## What's Changed
* learn: prototype sandlock learn subcommand by @ghazariann in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/113
* fix(net): close a sendto non-IP destination-policy TOCTOU (sendto half of #130) by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/154
* Follow-up fixes from the PR #113 review by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/155
* learn/cow: fix the two cli_test failures CI never saw; run the full workspace suite in CI by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/163
* fix(sandbox): drain the capture pipes while the child runs (#149) by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/166
* core: stop stealing the tty foreground group from embedding processes by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/168
* sandlock learn follow-up fixes by @ghazariann in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/165
* cow: subtree-aware whiteouts with a durable deletion log and type-aware copy-up by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/162
* Feat/control socket introspection by @sachin2605 in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/153
* pipeline: transactional sequential pipelines over a shared COW workdir (RFC #65 Phase 1) by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/148
* Fix the riscv64 test sweep: hermetic collapse tests, unique sandbox names by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/172
* Child stderr fidelity: default SIGPIPE on exec, opt-out for the txn stderr tee by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/173
* Control socket follow-ups: inspect rename, collision hard-fail, API narrowing by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/171
* feat(ffi): expose fs_mount_ro, and reject :ro/:rw in the Python profile parser by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/180
* feat(core): apply max_open_files as RLIMIT_NOFILE in the child by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/181
* build wheels for py 3.14 and runs tests on 3.13 and 3.14 as well by @apollo13 in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/157
* seccomp: accept syscall group names in both --extra-deny-syscall and --extra-allow-syscall by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/167
* checkpoint: restore through the execve stub, remove the injection engine by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/184
* fix(core): refuse a byte size that does not fit instead of wrapping it to zero by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/190
* Fix memory accounting: exec drift, exit leak, budget laundering, and kill targeting by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/189
* Make learning sandboxes visible and clean up inspect output by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/188
* fix(core): sweep inherited fds with close_range, not /proc by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/191
* chroot: fix chdir to short paths, and the resolver bugs behind it by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/193

## New Contributors
* @apollo13 made their first contribution in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/157

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/compare/v0.8.5...v0.8.6

name: v0.8.5
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(core): streaming-stdio popen → Process with per-stream StdioMode by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/118
* feat(ffi): C ABI for streaming-stdio popen — sandlock_popen + handle_kill by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/120
* sandlock-oci: wire networking and HTTP ACL from io.sandlock.<section>.<field> annotations by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/122
* feat(python): streaming-stdio popen — Sandbox.popen + Process (RFC #67) by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/123
* feat(go): streaming-stdio Popen — Process with per-stream StdioMode (RFC #67) by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/124
* fix(net): pass through connected AF_UNIX sendmsg under a destination policy by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/125
* Expose restore_interactive through the C ABI and Python SDK by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/126
* refactor(net): restructure the network module into parse/decide/execute phases by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/128
* fix(net): cap child-controlled sockaddr length before reading it by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/129
* feat(ffi): surface the terminating reason (timeout/signal/kill) through the C ABI and SDKs by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/136
* feat(net): credential injection primitives — inject an auth secret in the proxy (RFC #66) by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/127
* feat(net): support the '*' wildcard in --net-allow-bind by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/137
* Relocate vDSO/vvar on restore so libc programs resume by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/140
* feat(net): apply scheme-less --net-allow/--net-deny rules to both TCP and UDP by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/139
* credential: address the four remaining findings from the PR #127 review by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/138
* checkpoint: execve-stub restore path (primitive proof) by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/141
* fix(checkpoint): restore file-backed mappings and fds under a chroot by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/142
* fix: RISC-V test portability and exec fd-redirect argv[0] preservation by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/147
* fix(cow): return ENOENT when opening a file deleted in the branch by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/144
* fix(net): canonicalize v4-mapped IPv6 destinations before policy checks by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/151


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/compare/v0.8.4...v0.8.5

name: v0.8.4
body:
## What's Changed
* tests: assert outbound abstract unix socket connect is contained by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/94
* net: gate named unix socket access by fs-write grants by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/95
* Refactor sandbox runtime planning modules by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/96
* OCI compliant runtime for sandlock by @sachin2605 in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/98
* oci: review follow-ups (cleanup, root.readonly, tmpfs mounts, lifecycle fixes) by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/100
* oci: honor process.user via gid-capable run-as (single-id userns) by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/101
* net: close the sendmmsg named-unix and msg_name TOCTOU gaps by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/97
* oci: correct sub-core CPU quota mapping and add cpuset to cpu_cores affinity by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/102
* fix(net): empty net_allow deny-all bypass + strengthen false-passing security tests by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/103
* test: strengthen Rust policy_fn tests + fix c_smoke cdylib build (follow-ups to #103) by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/104
* Checkpoint/restore for sandlock sandboxes (transparent ptrace-injection) by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/105
* sandlock-oci: collapse process group on stop, atomic state.json and test writes by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/106
* sandlock-oci: single-sandbox OCI exec via sandlock-init by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/110
* sandlock-core: confine COW supervisor against symlink escape by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/114
* fs_deny: close the deny-bypass TOCTOU and namespace vectors by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/115
* sandlock-oci: containerd/CRI (Kubernetes) compatibility by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/116
* ci: add ubuntu-22.04 low-ABI job + end-to-end degrade test by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/107
* feat(go): Protection opt-out parity — AllowDegraded / Disable by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/117
* Mount host /proc and /sys into chroot sandboxes, cgroup-aware and read-only by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/119

## New Contributors
* @sachin2605 made their first contribution in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/98

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/compare/v0.8.3...v0.8.4

name: v0.8.0
body:
## What's Changed
* policy_fn: extend execve argv freeze to peer processes (#27) by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/33
* network: replace net_allow_hosts/net_connect with unified net_allow (#32) by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/34
* feat(seccomp): ExtraHandler — user-supplied syscall handlers by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/20
* argv-safety: register children at fork time by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/35
* net-allow: support `*` in port position for any-port wildcard by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/37
* feat(seccomp): Handler trait + IntoIterator-shaped run_with_extra_handlers (Follow-up A) by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/36
* Make syscall policy explicit; rename deny to blocklist by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/38
* test: switch /etc probe from /etc/os-release to /etc/group by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/39
* netlink: deny socket families outside a small allowlist by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/40
* net_allow: scheme-prefixed rules with per-protocol destination filtering by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/41
* Sectioned profile schema and Sandbox API consolidation by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/42
* sandbox: split spawn() into create()/start() for OCI-style lifecycle by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/45
* feat(ffi): C ABI for the Handler trait (RFC #43) by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/44
* core: restore port-remap transparency and tighten bind path by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/48
* core: drain seccomp notifications via AsyncFd, remove per-sandbox blocking thread by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/50
* test: use spawn() in pause/resume tests to avoid thread race by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/51
* ffi: fix sandlock_spawn failure under multi-threaded callers with restricted seccomp (#47) by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/49
* feat(python): Handler wrapper on the C ABI (RFC #43) by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/46
* core: add Sandbox::spawn() that awaits execve completion by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/52
* mcp: import-by-entrypoint tool execution and injected workspace param by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/55
* feat(python): ergonomic layer — read_path + 4 presets + dedicated docs page by @dzerik in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/54
* Fix Landlock path rules on non-directory paths (files, devices, FIFOs) by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/57
* Fix COW statx and execve for files in the upper layer by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/58
* Resolve thread-group leader in dup_fd_from_pid for pre-6.9 kernels by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/59
* Rename run_with_extra_handlers to run_with_handlers by @congwang-mk in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/56

## New Contributors
* @dzerik made their first contribution in https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/pull/20

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/multikernel/sandlock/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0

name: v0.7.0
